scientific_integrity: Two independent complete enumeration algorithms, directly checking all 1,048,576 masks, agree on all face and facet counts. The second also verifies the complete orbit partition and unique 11-to-12 extension.
scientific_limitations: The exact classification concerns only the labeled twenty-vertex graph \(H(5,2)\) and its natural \(S_5\times C_2\) action. No larger-family extension or absolute historical novelty proof is claimed.
title: A gapped minimal-alliance spectrum and twelve dissociation orbits of the Desargues graph
